Step 3. By the skew-symmetric spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01310013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the skew-symmetric spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Laplace interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
